name: Channel Bars
description: Stacked bars by channel with a dashed goal line and the best day marked, in a card.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per column, e.g. days of the week.

props.name: series
props.type: { name: string; data: number[]; color?: string }[]
props.description: Stacked from the bottom up, in order. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: goal
props.description: Draws a dashed goal line at this value, labelled in the right margin.

props.name: goalLabel
props.description: Text before the goal value and in the legend.

props.name: bestLabel
props.description: Small label over the highest column. Pass null to leave it out.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip and legend. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels on the left. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend with each series' total.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "this week".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts delta, note, action, footer and every other prop of a div.
